native_fixes.name: sparkinfer-mixed-trellis-runtime-counts
native_fixes.reason: Runtime tier counts and raw-pointer bindings let one compiled mixed-Trellis launch safely serve the 206/50 and 160/96 layer splits without stale specialization or duplicate compiled kernels

native_fixes.name: tp4-dcp4-lossless-auto-policy
native_fixes.reason: TP4/DCP4 has one query partition: exact query split plus full CKV gather uses two indexer shards with owner merge disabled, avoiding the old pure-overhead owner exchange while preserving lossless transport

native_fixes.name: sparkinfer-fp8-gather-validity
native_fixes.reason: The raw E4M3 query-gather ABI uses exact 16-byte transactions and ignores invalid empty-shard contributors instead of allowing zero-times-NaN contamination

native_fixes.name: sparkinfer-online-k6-e8m0-small-row-scales
native_fixes.reason: The small-row fused-MoE path loads E8M0 K32 scales for online-K6 gate and up projections instead of falling through the older packed-E4M3 branch

turnkey_overlays.name: vllm-serial-spec-warning
turnkey_overlays.reason: Serial GLM MTP adds zero scheduler slots; guard the generic sub-8192 warning with scheduled_token_delta > 0 so a proven 3072-token prefill shape is not mislabeled as undersized

turnkey_overlays.name: exl3-parity-abi-compatibility
turnkey_overlays.reason: The idempotent compatibility gate remains until the r26 EXL3 eager-parity call contract is independently verified native

turnkey_overlays.name: exl3-mixed-k-compatibility
turnkey_overlays.reason: r26 owns the mixed-K path; the idempotent turnkey patcher verifies and skips it
